```{=typst}
#let mk(n) = box(baseline: 22%, circle(radius: 5.8pt, fill: rgb("#d9480f"), stroke: none, inset: 0pt)[#set align(center + horizon); #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#n]])
#let tick = box(baseline: 12%, width: 10pt, height: 10pt, stroke: 0.9pt + luma(70), radius: 2pt)
#let shot(path, w: 100%) = block(breakable: false, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(150), radius: 6pt, clip: true, image(path, width: w))
#let typebox(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#f1f6fd"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 5pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt), body)
#let tip(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#fff4e6"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d9480f")), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt, body)
// One step: the box to tick, its number and what to do on the left; its screen on the right.
#let step(n, body, img: none, w: 100%, left: 40%, after: none) = block(breakable: false, above: 9pt, below: 9pt, width: 100%)[
  #set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em)
  #let words = grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, [#tick #h(1pt) *#n.*], body)
  #if img == none { words } else {
    grid(columns: (left, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: (top, top), words, align(center, shot(img, w: w)))
  }
  #if after != none { v(4pt); after }
]
```

::: {.lead}
Today you work with the sales of a small shop in **Excel** on the lab computer: you sort, filter, colour and make a chart. Do the tasks in order. The **orange
numbers** in each picture show where to click. Tick the box `#tick`{=typst} after each step. Stuck? Raise your hand.
:::

- **You need:** a lab computer with Excel. **Nothing to download:**
  you type the text yourself.
- **Time:** about 35 minutes. Your Excel may look a little different:
  the names of the buttons are the same.

## Task 1 · Open Excel and type the sales

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Search* on the taskbar #mk(1). Type *excel*. Click *Excel* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-open-1.png", w: 80%, left: 32%)
#step(2, [Click *Blank workbook* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-open-2.png", w: 36%, left: 32%)
#step(3, [Click *A1*. Type the table. Press *Tab* to go to the next cell, and *Enter* at the end of a row:], after: [#v(2pt) #align(center, table(columns: (2.6cm, 2.2cm, 2cm), inset: 4pt, stroke: 0.6pt + luma(90), fill: none, [*Item*], [*Sales (JD)*], [*Type*], [Water], [12], [Drinks], [Cake], [25], [Food], [Juice], [18], [Drinks], [Sandwich], [30], [Food], [Tea], [9], [Drinks], [Chips], [15], [Food]))])
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 2 · Sort: the biggest sales first

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click one cell of *Sales (JD)*, for example *B2* #mk(1). \ Click the *Data* tab #mk(2). Click *Z→A* #mk(3). \ Sandwich (30) is first now: whole rows moved together.], img: "images/lab-sort-1.png", w: 100%, left: 38%)
```

## Task 3 · Filter: only the drinks

```{=typst}
#step(1, [On the *Data* tab, click *Filter* #mk(1): an arrow in each heading. \ Click the arrow of *Type* #mk(2). \ Tick only *Drinks* #mk(3) (untick Food). Click *OK* #mk(4).], img: "images/lab-filter-1.png", w: 100%, left: 38%)
#step(2, [Select the 3 sales of Drinks: the bar at the bottom of Excel shows *Sum: 39*. \ Then click *Data › Clear*: all the rows are back.])
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 4 · A colour rule: the big sales in red

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Select *B2:B7*: drag from B2 to B7 #mk(1). \ *Home › Conditional Formatting* #mk(2) › *Highlight Cells Rules* › *Greater Than* #mk(3). \ Type *20* #mk(4). Click *OK* #mk(5).], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-cf-1.png", w: 92%)))
```

## Task 5 · A column chart with a title

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Select *A1:B7* #mk(1): the items and their sales, with the headings. \ Click the *Insert* tab #mk(2). Click the column chart #mk(3), then *Clustered Column*. \ Click *Chart Title* #mk(4) and type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Sales of the week]], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-chart-1.png", w: 92%)))
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 6 · Save your sheet

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Press *F12* (on a laptop: *Fn + F12*). \ Click *Desktop* #mk(1). In *File name*, type *sales-* and your first name #mk(2). Click *Save* #mk(3).], img: "images/lab-save-1.png", w: 94%, left: 32%)
```
